description: Bookings (business template), the administration side: action "createSlot" { set, start, end?, capacity, title?, repeat? } — repeat is a calendar rule (the usual RFC 5545 RRULE): { freq: "daily"|"weekly"|"monthly"|"yearly", interval?, byDay? (["MO","WE"]; monthly "2TU" = second Tuesday, "-1FR" = last Friday), byMonthDay? (15, -1 = last day), byMonth?, until? (a date: that whole day) or count?, except? (dates left out), timeZone? (IANA: keeps the local hour when the clocks change) } or an RRULE string ("FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU,TH;COUNT=20"); its cases are slots sharing a series id, made a year ahead and the next ones as time goes by (no end needed), all or none. "updateSlot" { set, slot, scope?, start?, end?, capacity?, title?, repeat? } and "deleteSlot" { set, slot, scope? }: scope "one" (default; that case alone), "following" (this and the next) or "all" (every case not started yet), as in a calendar; bookings of cases that stay are kept, a case that goes cancels its bookings with their credits or money back. "series" { set, series } (its rule), "slots" { set, from?, to? } (places left), "list" { set, slot? } (with who), "cancel" { set, booking, refund? } (by default, refunded only within the set deadline), "move" { set, booking, toSlot }, "cancelSession" { set, slot, reason? } (the whole session, everyone gets their credits or money back; it stays in the agenda as cancelled), "times" { set, from?, to?, site?, staff?, step? } (the free times of a service booked at a time). A slot is a session of the business: createSlot and updateSlot also take site?, staff? and resource? (ids from neblla_business) and min? (the fewest people for it to take place): it must fit the hours of its site, professional and resource, the professional must be free and the resource must have a unit free, or it answers "busy" with what is taken (for a repetition, every case is checked: all or none, or skipBusy: true leaves the busy dates out). Sets are configured with neblla_update_app({ business: { booking: { <set>: { cancelHours, cost, creditKind } } } }), or paid at each booking with { cancelHours, pay: "booking", product }. A set is also a service: { name?, minutes?, min?, max?, confirmHours? (12 by default with a min: how long before the start the min must be reached, or the session is cancelled with everything given back), resources? ([ids], any of them), staff? (true or [ids]), steps? ([{ minutes, resources, staff? }], in a row: the bath, then the table), book? ("sessions": the business opens them, the default; "times": the client picks a free time and it is theirs alone; "open": the client picks a free time and others join, like padel) }. Users book with neblla.business.booking.
name: neblla_booking
